purpose: Public door of the Vetrina richieste (UD-163, Francesco 16/10/2026 15:44 «Esterni Tally, soci app»): ONE Tally form "Richieste alla SCD" for external parties, a branch per kind selected by the hidden field tipo. Members and families never use it (in-app area). Read by apps/superapp/src/lib/intake-links.ts.
intakeTallyFormUrl_rule: Set 17/10/2026: form YjDovq published by Francesco and linked to Make scenario 8002637. Format https://tally.so/r/<formId> only (no query string); the app adds tipo and the allowed non-personal hints. null closes every link («Modulo in preparazione»).

ingest.caller: service role only (future Make scenario «Tally richieste → scd_request_ingest», not created)

never: names, birth dates or health data of minors (the form asks only for an adult referent and an organisation)
test submissions on the live form (they create real rows and mails)
automatic mail to the requester: a person replies
